- **cost-based ranker** · part · aka: cost-based, CBR, costEstimate, cardinalityEstimate, numKeysEstimate, numDocsEstimate, estimatesMetadata, ceSource, multi-planning, multiplanner, plan ranking, planRankerMode, query knobs, queryKnobs, sampling-based cardinality

### aggregation explain

- **aggregation explain** · part — Aggregation explain on a multi-shard run reports a splitPipeline with shardsPart (stages executed on each shard) and mergerPart (stages executed once at the merge point), plus a shards section keyed by shard name; a single-shard or unsharded run shows only a flat stages array with no splitPipeline. · aka: explain for aggregate, aggregate explain, $cursor stage, executionStats for stages, nReturned per stage, executionTimeMillisEstimate, $lookup explain, hash join, HashLookup — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-18444

### explain plan

- **explain plan** · related · aka: explain, winningPlan, executionStats, IXSCAN, FETCH
